title: Colour palette
slide_intent: Teach designers to distinguish venue-specific colors from shared colors so that viewers can recognize which venue a communication represents.
strategic_value: The six venues can have their own hero colors while the parent museum retains access to the entire palette.
demonstration: Six named venue swatches form two rows above four common swatches. Each card gives reproduction values and a bracket identifies the parent brand’s access to all ten colors.
practical_value: Select a venue’s hero color or a shared supporting color. For Sheffield Museums core-brand materials, avoid combining more than two palette colors, excluding black and grey.

content_islands.name: Usage guidance
content_islands.spec: Under the heading, set separate instructions for the parent museum, the venue hero colors and the common supporting colors.

content_islands.name: Venue swatches
content_islands.spec: Arrange six cards in three columns and two rows. Attach a venue name, ink, screen and paint references to each.

content_islands.name: Common colors and bracket
content_islands.spec: Place four supporting swatches in a line below. Draw the bracket along both sets and label it for Sheffield Museums.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains that common colors pair with hero colors and provide alternatives when a hero color does not suit the message.
reference_purposes.Expression: Six venue swatches and four common swatches establish the palette’s visible range.
reference_purposes.Application: The chart assigns named colors to venues and supplies ink, screen and paint references.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Parent-brand materials should avoid more than two palette colors, excluding black and grey; venue materials should avoid another venue’s hero hue or a very similar hue.

ingredient.name: Venue and common palette
ingredient.role: Give venues individual color cues while providing shared alternatives for different messages.
ingredient.application: Use the promoted venue’s hero color as a background or highlight, or choose a common color when appropriate. Avoid another venue’s hero hue or a very similar hue. For parent-brand materials, avoid combining more than two palette colors, excluding black and grey.
ingredient.scope: The two-color limit appears under Sheffield Museums core-brand materials. Venue hero colors and common colors have separate guidance; the parent brand may use any of the ten colors.
